name: Life
description: Complex, offbeat Detective Charlie Crews returns to the force after serving time in prison for a crime he didn't commit. Crews' new lease on life has provided him with a Zen-like outlook, peace of mind and no need for vengeance, an attitude which can be challenging to maintain when someone he cares about is threatened — or when he is investigating the mystery surrounding the murder he was falsely accused of.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: After serving 12 hard years for a crime he didn't commit, Detective Charlie Crews is back on the LAPD with a new partner and a new zen attitude.

videos.title: Tear Asunder
videos.overview: Crews and Reese investigate a bride's murder; Crews realizes that a child may have witnessed the murders for which he was convicted.

videos.title: Let Her Go
videos.overview: An upscale family man is suspected of killing his wife, and Crews sees his ex-wife for the first time since getting out of jail.

videos.title: What They Saw
videos.overview: When a wealthy man is found murdered in his bed, Crews befriends the only suspect, a homeless thief camping outside the estate.

videos.title: The Fallen Woman
videos.overview: When an angel falls from the sky, Crews and Reese's murder investigation leads to a slippery Russian gangster.

videos.title: Powerless
videos.overview: Fearing that a rapist she met at an AA meeting will strike again, Dani enlists Crews' help to take him down.

videos.title: A Civil War
videos.overview: The murder of two Iranian American students sparks racial unrest as Crews and Reese race to rescue their kidnapped friend.

videos.title: Farthingale
videos.overview: While investigating the murder of a bigomist, Crews is suspected for the murder of policeman Ames.

videos.title: Serious Control Issues
videos.overview: While investigating the case of a murdered homeless girl, Reese and Crews stumble across a child who was kidnapped when he was three.

videos.title: Dig a Hole
videos.overview: Charlie and Dani track the killer of a Zen Master who was buried alive ten years prior.

videos.title: Fill It Up
videos.overview: Hoping to take down Jack Reese, Crews finds the Seybolts' murderer, but doesn't succeed in proving who set him up.

videos.title: Find Your Happy Place
videos.overview: Crews and Reese race the clock to stop a serial killer who’s locking people in boxes and leaving them to die all over L.A.

videos.title: Everything... All the Time
videos.overview: Crews and Reese discover that rich kids, steroids, and murder are a bad mix.

videos.title: The Business of Miracles
videos.overview: Charlie and Reese work a case so cold it's frozen.

videos.title: Not for Nothing
videos.overview: Crews must battle his own psychological prison when he and Reese take on a case where worst nightmares become reality.

videos.title: Crushed
videos.overview: Crews and Reese investigate a case where an online infatuation turns into a deadly crush.

videos.title: Did You Feel That?
videos.overview: In the chaos of an L.A. earthquake, a killer sets a trap for Crews.

videos.title: Jackpot
videos.overview: Crews and Reese investigate the murder of a multi-million dollar lottery winner whose number was up.

videos.title: Black Friday
videos.overview: Prices aren't the only things falling when Crews and Reese investigate a man's death in a mall the morning of Black Friday.

videos.title: Badge Bunny
videos.overview: When the girlfriend of a cop is murdered, Crews and Reese must play a literal game of good cop bad cop to find the killer.

videos.title: Evil... and His Brother Ziggy
videos.overview: Reese and Crews take a trip to an Indian reservation to find out who killed the last sheriff standing.

videos.title: Canyon Flowers
videos.overview: A food bank delivery man is found murdered and buried up to his neck, surrounded by flower petals in a backyard. Crews and Reese believe the incident may be related to a cult from the 1970s. Crews confronts Mickey Rayborn, despite warnings from the FBI.

videos.title: Trapdoor
videos.overview: While investigating a triple execution-style homicide, Reese and Crews go up against an old nemesis, a Russian mob boss who has woven a deadly and wicked web.

videos.title: Re-Entry
videos.overview: After a Space Shuttle pilot is found shot to death after managing to land his private plane, Crews and Reese must determine if it was suicide or murder.

videos.title: Mirror Ball
videos.overview: When the lead singer of a cover band is found dead on stage, Crews and Reese must go through a string of impersonators to find the real killer.

videos.title: I Heart Mom
videos.overview: Crews and Reese begin their investigation and discover the victim was running an elaborate construction scam that left his clients without roofs or money.

videos.title: Hit Me Baby
videos.overview: Reese receives and offer to join an FBI organized crime task force, leaving Crews and Stark to partner up. The former partners work on a case of a philandering financial advisor who was murdered and discover a case of corporate and political corruption.

videos.title: Shelf Life
videos.overview: Crews and Starks investigate the murder of an Iraq war soldier who despite being killed in broad daylight on a crowded sidewalk, no one witnessed the crime.

videos.title: 3 Women
videos.overview: With his new overachieving partner, Crews investigates the murder of a woman who was in a relationship with her just-released convict pen pal.

videos.title: 5 Quarts
videos.overview: Crews and Seever are under pressure to solve the murder of an assistant coroner; a murder that if left unsolved, could jeopardize all of their closed cases.

videos.title: Initiative 38
videos.overview: When the wife of a prominent campaign runner is murdered, Crews and Seever wonder if her death is related to a controversial gun ban initiative that she spearheaded.

videos.title: One
videos.overview: When Roman wants to trade Reese for Rayborn, whom he's convinced is still alive, Crews launches a covert crusade to find his partner, which brings him answers to long-standing questions along the way.
